summary: Froze the insights read-model contract as ADR 0014 (docs/adr/0014-insights-read-model-contract.md), the docs-only precondition for the PH-272 implementation slice. After verifying the actual contracts (ReconciliationCase x-owner=insights owned_fact with status draft/pending/approved/rejected/superseded/closed, required source_refs/difference_cents/owner_member_id/resolution_note and readOnly case_key/rule_code/coverage_key/snapshot_watermark; MetricDefinition x-owner=insights read_projection with metric_id/name/formula_version/as_of_date/scope; commands insights.reconciliation.refresh/v1, insights.reconciliation.case.update/v1, insights.export.create/v1 and their canonical events; ADR 0013 owner/migration/bootstrap decisions), the ADR freezes three first-slice read-only interfaces: period_precheck_snapshot (contracts/time/cash/settlement/costing/core read-only blockers/warnings, zero writes, no lock/period action), reconciliation_case_list/snapshot (strict canonical ReconciliationCase fields/status transitions, refresh creates draft/pending, case.update only draft->pending->approved/rejected->closed, superseded on refresh replacement, request_token idempotency, concurrent single winner, pagination 200) and project_workbench_summary (contract value/recognized revenue/cost/cash/open-item/budget-ETC, missing values null+missing rather than 0, MetricDefinition references), plus the role matrix (owner/finance/auditor full, pm own projects, member denied), integer-cent/ROUND_HALF_UP caliber, the no-business-write boundary (no SourceConsumption/AccountingEvent/LedgerPosting/business facts; MetricSnapshot is a non-canonical internal read model), the deferred export, the exact future implementation whitelist for PH-272 and the rejection list. The ADR number 0014 was verified free (0010-0013 occupied). PH-257/PH-262 spec decision/risk text now references ADR 0014; tasks.json marks PH-277 done with handoff, refreshes PH-257/PH-262 blockers and adds PH-277 to PH-272's dependencies with updated blockers (PH-272 spec is outside this task's allowed_paths, so only its task contract was synced - disclosed). No scaffold, product code, migration, contract-schema change or runtime behavior was written.
